problem: Neighborhoods with shared community kitchens often face chaotic scheduling, overlapping bookings, and lack of visibility into available cooking slots, leading to underutilized resources and conflicts among residents.
solution: A simple static web app that lets residents view a weekly calendar of kitchen slots, claim a slot, add a dish description, and see who else is cooking, all stored locally with optional export for offline sharing.
target_customers: Residents of housing complexes or co‑ops with a shared kitchen
Community organizers managing communal cooking events

competitors.name: Community Kitchen Scheduler
competitors.difference: Focuses on paid SaaS with login; our tool is free, static, and works offline with localStorage.

features: Slot claim with dish name and optional notes
Responsive design for mobile and desktop
Accessible keyboard navigation and ARIA labels

monetization.pricing_hypothesis: Offer a paid 'Pro' version that syncs calendars across devices via a low‑cost cloud storage API after validation.
monetization.free_tier: All core features work fully offline with localStorage; no limits on number of slots or users on a single device.

operating_costs: Current prototype: ₹0 within published free‑tier limits
launch_strategy: Create a public repo on GitHub and enable GitHub Pages
Share the link in local housing‑complex newsletters and community boards
Gather feedback via a short Google Form linked from the site

marketing_content.tagline: Cook together, schedule smarter – free kitchen slots for every neighbor.
marketing_content.social_post: 🚀 Launching Community Kitchen Planner – a free, offline‑first tool to book kitchen time, share dishes, and avoid clashes. Perfect for co‑ops, community centers, and anyone with a shared kitchen. Try it now at https://yourusername.github.io/community-kitchen-planner

tests: Open the site, click an empty slot, enter a dish name, and save – the slot should display the dish and persist after refresh.
Resize the browser to mobile width – the calendar should reflow into a single column and remain usable.
Use keyboard Tab to focus a slot and press Enter – the claim dialog opens, confirming keyboard accessibility.
next_improvements: Add iCal/Google Calendar export for each user's booked slots
Implement optional password‑protected sharing of the JSON file for multi‑device sync
Introduce a simple rating system for dishes to encourage community interaction
